text: The vision{H2377} of Obadiah.{H5662} Thus saith{H559} the Lord{H136} Jehovah{H3069} concerning Edom:{H123} We have heard{H8085} tidings{H8052} from Jehovah,{H3068} and an ambassador{H6735} is sent{H7971} among the nations,{H1471} [saying], Arise{H6965} ye, and let us rise up{H6965} against her in battle.{H4421}
